description: W. Gunawathie and Others v. P.D. Ratnetilaka W. Gunawathie and Others v. P.D. Ratnetilaka View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: W. Gunawathie and Others v. P.D. Ratnetilaka W. Gunawathie and Others v. P.D. Ratnetilaka View More
keywords: The Appellants challenged the District Court’s dismissal of their action alleging private nuisance arising from the Respondent’s timber depot operations. Held - no basis to disturb the District Judge’s factual finding that private nuisance had not been proved on a balance of probabilities; the Appellants had also failed to prosecute the appeal. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
